Briefing with Laurento and Lucita about situation with Lespia, Wehlen, Pales, Derdia, Morella, Sordland and Rumburg.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I walked into the council chambe..."
entries.dialogueText: As I walked into the council chambers, I found the other councilors already there, deep in conversation.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A superpower suddenly taking an in..."
entries.dialogueText: "A superpower suddenly taking an interest in this part of the continent -- what's next? All of our children will have to learn Arcasian?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The decision wasn't made with any..."
entries.dialogueText: "The decision wasn't made with any ill intent towards Rizia. There are greater global forces at work than what's happening in our corner of South Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What the superpowers decide affect..."
entries.dialogueText: "What the superpowers decide affects us, Mr. Esquibel. Their intent is of no importance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You started the meeting without me?""
entries.dialogueText: "You started the meeting without me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Care to catch me up?""
entries.dialogueText: "Care to catch me up?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""SILENCE!""
entries.dialogueText: "SILENCE!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All three fell silent. Laurento sta..."
entries.dialogueText: All three fell silent. Laurento stared at me, somewhat taken aback.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Excuse us, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse us, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The three of them noticed me and fe..."
entries.dialogueText: The three of them noticed me and fell silent.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We were just discussing the recent..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were just discussing the recent news concerning Lespia's membership in ATO."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree with Duchess Azaro. We sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree with Duchess Azaro. We should be very concerned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree with Mr. Esquibel. There's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree with Mr. Esquibel. There's nothing to worry about."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Why do you believe that, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why do you believe that, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""May I ask what makes you so certai..."
entries.dialogueText: "May I ask what makes you so certain?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With Arcasia's backing, Lespia is..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Arcasia's backing, Lespia is bound to strengthen its grip on Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arcasia has a track record of sowi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Arcasia has a track record of sowing instability. We can't afford another uprising."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia and Arcasia have been close..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia and Arcasia have been close for a decade. This just puts a name to it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Southern Merkopa cannot be allowed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Southern Merkopa cannot be allowed to fall under the influence of superpowers. We ought to be our *own* superpower."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The superpowers won't touch us as..."
entries.dialogueText: "The superpowers won't touch us as long as we have Rumburg as an ally."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia won't get too bold. Not wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia won't get too bold. Not with Valgsland and the CSP around to keep them in check."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""A very ambitious goal, considering..."
entries.dialogueText: "A very ambitious goal, considering how divided we are."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Which will certainly threaten the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which will certainly threaten the tenuous peace we have established with both nations."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Rarely has ATO expanded without ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rarely has ATO expanded without chaos following close behind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The day of my foreign policy counci..."
entries.dialogueText: The day of my foreign policy council meeting had arrived, and it was a hot one.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I spent a while wandering around, t..."
entries.dialogueText: I spent a while wandering around, then returned to the middle of the garden, where a series of stone sculptures were surrounded by Rizian palms and succulents.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't know anything about the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't know anything about the situation yet. We'll have to wait and see what happens."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A reasonable response, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "A reasonable response, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Names have weight, Your Majesty. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Names have weight, Your Majesty. So do atomic weapons."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Even worse, Your Majesty. That mea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even worse, Your Majesty. That means Rizia is caught in the middle."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Queen Beatrice is already making o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Beatrice is already making overtures towards Arcasia. With Queen Lena dead, which side do you think she'll take?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento walked to the chamber's ba..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento walked to the chamber's back wall and pulled down a map of southeastern Merkopa.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""What shall we discuss first?""
entries.dialogueText: "What shall we discuss first?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We need to talk about Wehlen.""
entries.dialogueText: "We need to talk about Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Isn't Pales the topic of the day?""
entries.dialogueText: "Isn't Pales the topic of the day?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I haven't heard much about the cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't heard much about the countries of the former Empire of Moridia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's going on in Sordland?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's going on in Sordland?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Now that the Colonel has decided t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that the Colonel has decided to retire, you mean?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""His successor is called Ewald Alph..."
entries.dialogueText: "His successor is called Ewald Alphonso. From everything I've heard, he's Soll's exact opposite."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's good, right?""
entries.dialogueText: "That's good, right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What does that mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "What does that mean?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just a gut feeling.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just a gut feeling."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just a feeling I have.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just a feeling I have."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Respectfully, Your Majesty, this c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Respectfully, Your Majesty, this council exists so that you may base your actions on more than mere gut feelings."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""What would you have us do, Duchess..."
entries.dialogueText: "What would you have us do, Duchess Azaro? We're on shaky enough ground with Lespia as it is."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of course we should act sensibly...."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course we should act sensibly. But we need to show the Republic and its new friends that Rizia can hold its own."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It depends. He's already institute..."
entries.dialogueText: "It depends. He's already instituted some major changes..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Think sweeping privatization and t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think sweeping privatization and tax cuts. Sollists forced out of power. More women in prominent positions-- although he has yet to pass the kind of liberatory reforms our beloved Lyza did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's too bad. I actually liked S..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's too bad. I actually liked Soll."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The feeling wasn't mutual. Soll's..."
entries.dialogueText: "The feeling wasn't mutual. Soll's disdain for the monarchy kept us shut out of trade negotiations with Sordland for decades."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Do you want to discuss Morella? Or..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you want to discuss Morella? Or Derdia?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Derdia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Derdia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Morella.""
entries.dialogueText: "Morella."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Ah, yes. The only fully Golcondist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. The only fully Golcondist nation in the world."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You've already heard about their n..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've already heard about their new left-wing ruling coalition, correct?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento rearranged some of the pap..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento rearranged some of the papers he was holding.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Relations with our onetime allies..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relations with our onetime allies have been turbulent at best since the civil war. The international unpopularity of current president Wiktor Smolak has only complicated matters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father made a deal with Wehlen..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father made a deal with Wehlen on good faith. Wehlen so far has respected the deal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All I ask is that Wehlen return Zi..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I ask is that Wehlen return Zille as promised. After that, I'm happy to cut ties."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia wouldn't be where we are tod..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia wouldn't be where we are today without Wehlen. We can't abandon our partnership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not a good look for us to rem..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not a good look for us to remain linked to them."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It's not wrong. One might see it t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not wrong. One might see it that way."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The return is scheduled for the en..."
entries.dialogueText: "The return is scheduled for the end of 1952, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Rumburg in particular has been voc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg in particular has been vocal about ending the Smolak regime. But as long as Wehlen still holds Zille, diplomacy is key."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Smolak has made nothing but enemie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Smolak has made nothing but enemies in the international arena, Rumburg chief among them. But yes, as long as Wehlen still holds Zille, diplomacy is paramount."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I was just about to bring up the G..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was just about to bring up the Grand Duchy."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Friendship Day is the 'celebration..."
entries.dialogueText: "Friendship Day is the 'celebration' that's been held in Zille each year since the treaty was signed."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Since Smolak took over, he's used..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since Smolak took over, he's used the occasion to trot out all the shiny new tanks Wehlen's oil money and United Contanan funding has bought him."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your presence will at the very lea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your presence will at the very least remind him of the occupation's temporary nature."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I know you and Duke Reinhart had a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you and Duke Reinhart had a rather ill-fated meeting some years ago. But it's not too late to mend those bridges."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm looking forward to it. Our nat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to it. Our nations have been estranged for too long."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I doubt it. He knows I showed Fath..."
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt it. He knows I showed Father his letter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as he doesn't expect too m..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as he doesn't expect too much from me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was Father's fault. He forced m..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was Father's fault. He forced me to betray the Duke's confidence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Reinhart reached out to me because..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reinhart reached out to me because he was desperate. Sooner or later, he'll come crawling back to us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still don't know why Axel even b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still don't know why Axel even bothered. He knows full well what Rizians think of his so-called 'country'."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I myself advised your father to sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I myself advised your father to speak with the new Duke of Pales. To no avail, of course."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your father's unfortunate passing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father's unfortunate passing has given us a chance for a fresh start with Duke Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I heard he reached out to you some..."
entries.dialogueText: "I heard he reached out to you some years ago. Perhaps that connection can be built upon."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""All he expects is a warmer recepti..."
entries.dialogueText: "All he expects is a warmer reception than the one Valero gave him. Which I would recommend anyway."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Perhaps now is our chance for a fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps now is our chance for a fresh start."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please enlighten me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please enlighten me."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""After years of infighting, the cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "After years of infighting, the country's left-leaning parties miraculously united in time to win this year's elections."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The politician who managed this fe..."
entries.dialogueText: "The politician who managed this feat is now Morella's new prime minister. Alma Saltana, or as she might prefer it, *Comrade* Alma Saltana."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo grimaced."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo grimaced.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Lespia and ATO are enough of a thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia and ATO are enough of a threat without the Malenyevists knocking at our back door."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Morella doesn't stand a chance of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella doesn't stand a chance of entering the Contanan Security Pact. Not with its current levels of poverty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But there are rumors that Prime Mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But there are rumors that Prime Minister Saltana has been arranging meetings with Valgslandian Chancellor Emmerich Hegel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Didn't Rizia and Valgsland used to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Didn't Rizia and Valgsland used to be allies?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll make him remember. By any mea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll make him remember. By any means necessary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm looking forward to it. I see n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to it. I see no reason why Rizia and Wehlen can't be close again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll talk to him. Maybe we can com..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll talk to him. Maybe we can come to a productive agreement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still don't know if he can be tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still don't know if he can be trusted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And how are our relations with Val..."
entries.dialogueText: "And how are our relations with Valgsland at the moment?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I must say that their Supreme Wise..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must say that their Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal did not approve of our ban on Golcondist pilgrims to Rizian holy sites."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You think Hegel is trying to get M..."
entries.dialogueText: "You think Hegel is trying to get Morella into the CSP?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Neutral at best, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Neutral at best, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can Morella be swayed away from Va..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can Morella be swayed away from Valgish influence?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento politely nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento politely nodded.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It's possible. But we'd have to ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's possible. But we'd have to have something to offer."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Not currently. But Valgsland throw..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not currently. But Valgsland throwing its support behind Morella's leftward turn is concerning enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. Malenyev and his fol..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. Malenyev and his followers are the real menace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arcasian liberalism is a far worse..."
entries.dialogueText: "Arcasian liberalism is a far worse threat to our way of life than Malenyevism."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as we remain on good terms..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as we remain on good terms with Morella, I don't care about the country's political leanings."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As for Morella's neighbor Derdia...""
entries.dialogueText: "As for Morella's neighbor Derdia..."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Laurento Esquibel: ""Our relations with them have becom..."]

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""An admirable impulse. But this is..."
entries.dialogueText: "An admirable impulse. But this is unfortunately only a ceremony, not a diplomatic talk."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Circumstances have changed since t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Circumstances have changed since the '20s, of course. But it's good that you are still holding out that hope."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""There is one more country we haven..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is one more country we haven't discussed. Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is there even anything to discuss?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is there even anything to discuss? They're our allies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, how are my in-laws?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, how are my in-laws?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I always expected Beatrice to turn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always expected Beatrice to turn on me after Lena died. I'm amazed she's stayed allied with us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""For the moment, Queen Beatrice and..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the moment, Queen Beatrice and her country are firmly allied with Rizia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, for the time being, Queen Bea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, for the time being, Queen Beatrice and her country are firmly allied with Rizia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course. Queen Beatrice and her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. Queen Beatrice and her country are firmly allied with Rizia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our allies, Queen Beatrice and her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our allies, Queen Beatrice and her country, are doing fine from what we're seeing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In what way?""
entries.dialogueText: "In what way?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Considering the state of Zille sin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Considering the state of Zille since it landed in Wehlen's hands, I see no point in remaining diplomatic. Have you been there lately? It's an industrial wasteland."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Wehlen's access to Zille's land an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen's access to Zille's land and resources helped bring it out of recession after the war. Smolak will have difficulty letting go of such a valuable asset."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Some argue Wehlen did little but a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some argue Wehlen did little but accelerate the development that was already occurring in the region prior to the handover."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Either way, Wehlen's access to Zil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Either way, Wehlen's access to Zille's land and resources helped bring it out of recession after the war. Smolak will have difficulty letting go of such a valuable asset."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can we count on him to honor the t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can we count on him to honor the terms of the treaty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can the international community be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can the international community be relied on to intervene if Smolak breaks a signed pact?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about the people of Zille? Su..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the people of Zille? Surely they can't wait for the land to be returned to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will act diplomatically with Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will act diplomatically with President Smolak. We can sweeten the deal if, necessary. I will appease him until we get Zille back."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Half of the country's native Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Half of the country's native Rizian population fled during the civil war. Like the Queen Mother's parents, I recall."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Given how many countries depend on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given how many countries depend on Wehzek oil, either directly or indirectly, I wouldn't be so sure about that."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Smolak's current focus is on eradi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Smolak's current focus is on eradicating terrorism by the Bluds, a Golcondist ethnic group native to Wehlen and Sordland. He's been very vocal about his desire for cooperation on that front."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Smolak is not as weak as he seems...."
entries.dialogueText: "Smolak is not as weak as he seems. It will take a great deal of time and effort before our firepower matches his. He may act bold."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Among those who were stubborn enou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Among those who were stubborn enough to stay, opinion is divided. We have to remember that it's been almost 25 years."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""In the meantime, any perceived agg..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, any perceived aggression on our part may only give him an excuse to break it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The funding Wehlen has received fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The funding Wehlen has received from United Contana may also have Smolak believing he can act with impunity."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Not all Bluds are terrorists, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not all Bluds are terrorists, Your Grace. Mr. Smolak is particularly interested in the separatist group known as the Bludish Freedom Front. Who have been rumored to be receiving support from none other than Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's that?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That name's got to be some kind of..."
entries.dialogueText: "That name's got to be some kind of joke."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""President Smolak fancies himself t..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak fancies himself the humorous type, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Speaking of Lyza, she's the one wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Speaking of Lyza, she's the one who first opened trade negotiations with Sordland back when it was still a kingdom. But Soll's disdain for the monarchy kept us from continuing down that path."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The Alphonso administration, meanw..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Alphonso administration, meanwhile, has no such qualms about royalty. In fact, his new development minister Gus Manger has already had personal business dealings in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Our friend Mr. Montoro of Rizian R..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our friend Mr. Montoro of Rizian Royal Gold has been making overtures to the Sordish oligarchy, it seems. Birds of crassly ostentatious plumage flock together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't like your tone, Hugo. Rust..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't like your tone, Hugo. Rusty and the Sordish oligarchs are self-made men. I respect that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What does Sordland want from us?""
entries.dialogueText: "What does Sordland want from us?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That hasn't been disclosed yet. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "That hasn't been disclosed yet. The country already has abundant gas resources. They could be looking to shore up their Central Bank with gold in the wake of Alphonso's privatization spree."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Shall I continue?""
entries.dialogueText: "Shall I continue?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not sure if I trust either Alp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure if I trust either Alphonso or his minister. But I'm open to proposals."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It would be a feat to repair our t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be a feat to repair our ties with Sordland. Perhaps the glory days of Lyza are not lost after all."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A commoner with money is like a mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "A commoner with money is like a monkey with a wristwatch. Entertaining for a while, but what's he really going to do with it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wealthy commoners making plans beh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wealthy commoners making plans behind our back. It doesn't smell good."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Ms. Werner already mentioned the l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Werner already mentioned the large amounts of gold we export to the country through their strategic Port Grim."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We also have a deal allowing Rumbu..."
entries.dialogueText: "We also have a deal allowing Rumburg's ships priority access to our ports in Porte Drazon and Monqiz. We are, in essence, their gateway to the Antacean Sea."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Militarily speaking, the alliance..."
entries.dialogueText: "Militarily speaking, the alliance doesn't amount to much. Rumburg will supply us with arms in case of war, but neither of our countries is officially obligated to come to the other's aid."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are these rumors about Rumbur..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are these rumors about Rumburg interfering in Wehlen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is the Queen plotting anything aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is the Queen plotting anything against Sordland?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It won't be behind your back for l..."
entries.dialogueText: "It won't be behind your back for long, Your Majesty. Both Alphonso and Manger want to talk to you."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Not a bad analogy, Your Grace. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not a bad analogy, Your Grace. But these are the men who hold the power in Sordland. We'll have to deal with them sooner or later."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duchess Azaro mentioned Rumburg wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Azaro mentioned Rumburg was getting closer to Arcasia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard that Rumburg has been g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard that Rumburg has been getting closer to Arcasia?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, the Queen is in trade talks w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, the Queen is in trade talks with Arcasia as well as western neighbors Nahrbuk and Erdmarg."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Does Rumburg want anything else fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Does Rumburg want anything else from us?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The countries haven't been in over..."
entries.dialogueText: "The countries haven't been in overt conflict since the 15-Day War."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But to answer your question, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "But to answer your question, Your Majesty, I wouldn't be surprised. We're already fairly sure Rumburg is arming Bludish separatists in Wehlen. The same might well be happening across the border in Bergia."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Nothing's been proven, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing's been proven, Your Majesty. But we're fairly sure Rumburg has been arming Bludish separatists in the country's northeast. The same might be happening across the border in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The country's energy needs are ins..."
entries.dialogueText: "The country's energy needs are insatiable. It's been reaching out to any country with oil or natural gas resources."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Maybe not from us, but the country..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe not from us, but the country's energy needs are insatiable."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Queen's interested in any coun..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Queen's interested in any country with oil or natural gas resources."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""In other words, if we do start dri..."
entries.dialogueText: "In other words, if we do start drilling in that new field off Ales, I expect Her Excellency will soon come calling."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's smart. Queen Beatrice will..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's smart. Queen Beatrice will get further with these kinds of destabilization efforts than with outright hostility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So our alliance with Rumburg is a..."
entries.dialogueText: "So our alliance with Rumburg is a liability when it comes to relations with Wehlen and Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who's to say she won't try the sam..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who's to say she won't try the same shenanigans with us?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I wouldn't rule out the possibilit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't rule out the possibility of escalation. Both countries are rich in the one thing Rumburg still needs: energy."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""She'd have nothing to gain from it..."
entries.dialogueText: "She'd have nothing to gain from it, Your Majesty. We're already giving Rumburg nearly everything it wants."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Except natural gas. If we do end u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Except natural gas. If we do end up with a stake in the new gas field, I expect Her Excellency will soon come calling."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our alliance shouldn't stop us fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our alliance shouldn't stop us from pursuing diplomacy with either nation."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But I wouldn't rule out the possib..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I wouldn't rule out the possibility of escalation from Rumburg's side. Both countries are rich in the one thing Rumburg still needs: energy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's presumptuous of her. There..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's presumptuous of her. There are plenty of other potential uses for that gas."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Her Excellency has made Rumbu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Her Excellency has made Rumburg's oil and natural gas needs plainly known. If we end up with a stake in that new field, I fully expect her to come calling."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Becoming one of Rumburg's main ene..."
entries.dialogueText: "Becoming one of Rumburg's main energy suppliers would definitely strengthen our partnership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're getting ahead of yourself...."
entries.dialogueText: "You're getting ahead of yourself. Ownership of that field hasn't even been decided yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is Rumburg even using all of..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is Rumburg even using all of this energy for?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They've been manufacturing a lot m..."
entries.dialogueText: "They've been manufacturing a lot more than KA-74s lately. I've heard stories about experimental weapons that would put Arcasia's to shame."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But you see now how important it i..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you see now how important it is for that decision to be made in Rizia's favor."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It would. Whether that's good or b..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would. Whether that's good or bad in the eyes of the international community is another question."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""True. Both Morella and Derdia are..."
entries.dialogueText: "True. Both Morella and Derdia are struggling to meet their own energy needs."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Fortunately, we have living eviden..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, we have living evidence of that bond right here at this table."

entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Um, yes. Don't worry, Aunt Bea sti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Um, yes. Don't worry, Aunt Bea still dotes on me. I'm like the daughter she never had."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He looked meaningfully at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Beatrice still dotes on Vina. She'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Beatrice still dotes on Vina. She's like the daughter she never had."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, Beatrice is still fond of me...."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Beatrice is still fond of me. She knows how much I loved Lena."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Good. I hope it's clear to the you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I hope it's clear to the young lady how important it is for her to stay in Her Excellency's good graces."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I was referring to Vina. But I'm g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was referring to Vina. But I'm glad you've stayed in Her Excellency's good graces."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Good. See to it that you remain in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. See to it that you remain in Her Excellency's good graces."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina is a human being, She's not a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina is a human being, She's not a diplomatic tool."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's a human being, Uncle Hugo. N..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's a human being, Uncle Hugo. Not a diplomatic tool."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Queen is still fond of me as w..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Queen is still fond of me as well. She knows how much I loved my Lena."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Maybe it's time we both arranged a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe it's time we both arranged a visit with Aunt Bea."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina pressed her pencil down on her..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina pressed her pencil down on her notepad so hard that it broke with an audible snap.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You heard him, Vina. Maybe it's ti..."
entries.dialogueText: "You heard him, Vina. Maybe it's time we arranged a visit with dear Aunt Bea."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Anything for the Kingdom.""
entries.dialogueText: "Anything for the Kingdom."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's okay. I understand Uncle Hugo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's okay. I understand Uncle Hugo's point. I'll be sure to keep up correspondence with Aunt Bea."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The young lady is a princess. Ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "The young lady is a princess. There are certain expectations that come with the role."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Thanks for listening, everyone. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for listening, everyone. I do hope I haven't been too much of a bore."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not at all, Mr. Esquibel. I've alw..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not at all, Mr. Esquibel. I've always enjoyed sharing in your expertise."

entries.title: Narrator: "I didn't know much about the many p..."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't know much about the many plants and flowers on display around me. But they were pleasing to look at and provided some welcome shade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before he was my butler, my friend..."
entries.dialogueText: Before he was my butler, my friend had explained to me that the plants and flowers here were laid out geographically: Rikan ferns in the east, Xinan lilies to the south, a Rumburg-style rose garden in the north.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Sooner, in this case, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sooner, in this case, Your Majesty. I'll contact you once Alphonso has agreed on a date for his visit."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I'll contact you once Alphonso has..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll contact you once Alphonso has agreed on a date for his visit."

entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento looked at Hugo, amused."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento looked at Hugo, amused.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked out of the chambers, glad..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked out of the chambers, glad to be done for the day.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As we all know, House Toras has hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we all know, House Toras has historical ties to the late Valgos Empire. But Chancellor Hegel isn't exactly brimming with nostalgia for that era."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""House Toras was close with the Val..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Toras was close with the Valgos Empire, yes. But it's been 30 years since the revolution. And Chancellor Hegel isn't exactly nostalgic for the old days."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo grimaced."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo grimaced.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Lespia and ATO are enough of a thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia and ATO are enough of a threat without the Malenyevists knocking at our back door."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This new prime minister 'Comrade'..."
entries.dialogueText: "This new prime minister 'Comrade' Alma Saltana worries me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Respectfully, Your Grace, there's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Respectfully, Your Grace, there's nothing 'reasonable' about allowing Arcasia and its puppets to spread instability across the globe."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Compared to his brother Njolma, Ax..."
entries.dialogueText: "Compared to his brother Njolma, Axel Reinhart seems far more amenable to a thaw between our countries."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He wasn't even born when Rizia and..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wasn't even born when Rizia and Pales were fighting. And I suspect he is beginning to see the disadvantages of staying connected to Lespia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me more about the current rel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me more about the current relationship between Pales and Lespia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales still has a Rizian-speaking..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales still has a Rizian-speaking population, right? How influential are they?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where's Valgsland in all this? Doe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where's Valgsland in all this? Does Pales have any relationship with the republic?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The Grand Duchy has been heavily d..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Grand Duchy has been heavily dependent on the Republic of Lespia since the 1920s, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our northern neighbor has taken ex..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our northern neighbor has taken extensive advantage of the natural gas reserves off the southern Palesian coast."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In addition to the resulting incom..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition to the resulting income, Pales has access to Lespian technology and military equipment, which at the moment surpasses our own."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""They are a minority, but a vocal o..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are a minority, but a vocal one."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I would categorize them as neutral..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would categorize them as neutral but frosty, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Queen Lyza's diplomacy kept us on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Lyza's diplomacy kept us on good terms with Lespia for a time after their transition to democracy. But things were beginning to sour even before the Pales conflict."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We still maintain embassies in eac..."
entries.dialogueText: "We still maintain embassies in each other's countries. But I haven't met with their foreign ministry since before the election of their new prime minister, Alvarez."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Having Arcasia behind them might w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having Arcasia behind them might well embolden Lespia to push for a larger share in the MITZ. But they'd also have Valgsland and Morella to contend with."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not an immediate one, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not an immediate one, Your Majesty. But we must be watchful."

entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We have seen Arcasian-backed revol..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Qinal's ATO membership was already..."
entries.dialogueText: "Qinal's ATO membership was already cause for concern five years ago. With Lespia in the alliance as well, Arcasia's influence is present to both our north and our south. There is great potential for destabilization."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are the security implications..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Lespia already houses Arcasian mil..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "I can't say for certain that all that firepower will be directed against us in case of a conflict. But it does enhance the threat that Lespia -- and, yes, potentially Pales -- poses to our kingdom."

entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I will point out that our stance o..."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Yes, Morella hasn't allowed Derdia..."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I sympathize with Morella. Those G..."
entries.dialogueText: "I sympathize with Morella. Those Golcondist lunatics should stay in their own country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then how are Derdian migrants reac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then how are Derdian migrants reaching Rizia?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Poor Derdians. They can't catch a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Poor Derdians. They can't catch a break."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Mostly by boat across the Gulf of..."

entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Pilgrimages play a significant rol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pilgrimages play a significant role in Golcondism, unfortunately. Whether to holy sites in Rizia and Morella, or to the Sordish Archsanctuary of Deyr."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Don't feel too sorry for them. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't feel too sorry for them. They win their share of border skirmishes."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Say what you will about Derdians'..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It's part of their warrior culture..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's part of their warrior culture, Duchess. Their practice is centered on martial discipline and physical strength."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It'd be good to have a culture lik..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Frankly, they scare me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, they scare me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can Derdia be bargained with?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can Derdia be bargained with?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Everyone can be bargained with, Yo..."

entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""They're not as dangerous as they m..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're not as dangerous as they may seem. Like Wehlen, Derdia is geopolitically isolated. They have few allies aside from the Bludish population in Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It will be hard to bargain with De..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be hard to bargain with Derdia without compromising our ban. But it may be possible."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's everything, isn't it, Mr. E..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's everything, isn't it, Mr. Esquibel?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I will remind the council of our p..."

entries.title: Narrator: "My councilors looked at me in expec..."
entries.dialogueText: My councilors looked at me in expectation.

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think Hugo has the right idea. A..."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I like Elena's suggestion. Sealing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like Elena's suggestion. Sealing new economic pacts with other Merkopan countries will help us become a regional power in our own right."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree with Lucita that we cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree with Lucita that we cannot look weak in Lespia and Arcasia's eyes. Our military and intelligence should be our number one focus."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You all have very good ideas. I wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You all have very good ideas. I will consider a combination of these approaches."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""President Smolak has spent years f..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak has spent years fortifying his coastline. The sea approaches are heavily mined, and reinforced with layered naval batteries. United Contana's aid allowed Wehlen to significantly expand those defenses. A naval invasion across the gulf would be operationally unimaginable."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""For all his rhetoric, Smolak seeks..."
entries.dialogueText: "For all his rhetoric, Smolak seeks security and legitimacy. An outright attack would push him firmly into United Contana’s embrace, perhaps beyond retrieval."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If we move against Wehlen openly,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we move against Wehlen openly, we risk strengthening the very man we could wish to keep in check."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Additionally, our navy lacks the n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Additionally, our navy lacks the necessary amphibious capacity for a sustained landing. We also do not possess enough advanced vessels capable of reliably detecting and clearing minefields in the Gulf."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Zille is a different matter. It li..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille is a different matter. It lies on our mainland. There, we can exert intelligence and limited military pressure with far greater feasibility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then Zille is our only pressure po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then Zille is our only pressure point?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Could we overwhelm their defenses..."
entries.dialogueText: "Could we overwhelm their defenses with a rapid strike?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about air superiority? Could..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about air superiority? Could we neutralize their batteries from above?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The minefields and overlapping coa..."
entries.dialogueText: "The minefields and overlapping coastal guns would break any rapid assault before it reaches land."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Contanan radar and anti-air system..."
entries.dialogueText: "Contanan radar and anti-air systems would blunt our strikes long before their batteries are neutralized."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It is the only front where we can..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is the only front where we can apply controlled military and intelligence pressure from our mainland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have no desire for war. Wehlen s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no desire for war. Wehlen stood by us in a dire time. I will not forget that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We can maintain readiness without..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can maintain readiness without provoking the hand that once aided us."
